In the Council's assessment, recently incoming data point to a weaker demand pressure than previously expected, which will contribute to a faster return of inflation to the NBP inflation target.

The Council upheld the assessment that the decrease in inflation would be faster if supported by an appreciation of the zloty exchange rate, which would be consistent with prospects for inflation and economic activity.
